arms.mse_y: legacy name; fit response is original standardized float32 z, exactly frozen QRF; per-market/h leaf fixed from qrf_round4.json
arms.mse_abs: fit abs(z), retain original signed scalar z for leaf prediction
arms.rank_score: fit ndtri((average_rank(z)-0.5)/n) from fit-partition labels only; zero ties share average rank; retain original z for prediction
arms.mse_z2: fit z squared, retain original signed scalar z for prediction

leaf_selection: one leaf size per market-arm for B/C/D minimizing mean_h log(raw-return MQS_valid_arm_h / MQS_valid_A_seed11_h); A fixed old per-h leaves and no search
composite_selection: one arm per market from inner chosen-leaf macro log MQS; deterministic A,B,C,D tie order; secondary reference only; all four arms still evaluated on test
features: same36 context columns and phase-fitted scaler/clip as frozen QRF; no new feature, no NN
leaf_probabilities: Q.leaf_weights original-row uniform membership, bootstrap affects partitions only
ensemble: equal raw leaf probability mean across five seeds INCLUDING zero rows, then nonzero conditioning, then rule p and gamma; final conditional seed mixing weights proportional to each seed raw NZ mass
extra_ensemble_diagnostic: equal mixture of five separately conditioned fixed-p/smoothed final Fs, secondary only, not canonical anchor
fallback: zero NZ leaf mass -> currently matured nonzero uniform; all response keys require own target maturity<=query origin
transport: identity a=1,b=0; exact weighted ECDF CRPS; raw inverse transform exactly once
anchor_checks: A raw seed/ensemble weights exactly frozen QRF by source D-index; gamma0 via frozen probability-control evaluator exactly frozen rule-QRF; gamma.05 via frozen identity-reference evaluator exactly forest_reference_only; stop on mismatch
data: same canonical panel/cuts/origins/targets/scales and separate inner Dtr/final Drf; no test memory appending
primary_reporting: each arm retained with all seeds plus canonical ensemble; all market/h scores and gains, never promote composite or a selected seed after test
claim_scope: scalar transformed-response split mechanism, not a full-distribution impurity or new forest family; reused historical test is developmental
